verdict.rationale: Gumloop's trigger docs describe app triggers that fire when something happens in an external service, plus webhook triggers that any HTTP-POSTing app (Stripe, GitHub, scripts) can call. Message and email events are also covered: agents respond to Slack and Teams messages and can have a dedicated email address. Missing for 10: no documented list of supported app-trigger events (e.g. new CRM record or form submission specifically), no detail on trigger configuration or filtering, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
